# Huntington Solar Co (solarhuntington.com)

> A local solar guide for Huntington, NY and the Suffolk County north
> shore. The site explains solar costs, PSEG Long Island buyback rates,
> incentives and financing for homeowners, and connects them with
> installation. It is an educational and lead-generation resource, not
> a solar installation contractor.

## What this site does

- Explains what solar actually costs in Huntington and nearby towns,
  with local numbers rather than national averages.
- Breaks down PSEG Long Island billing and solar buyback rates.
- Covers federal ITC, New York State credits and Suffolk County
  incentives, plus lease vs loan vs PPA financing tradeoffs.
- Answers Town of Huntington permit and roof-suitability questions.
- Lets homeowners request a free solar quote by phone or form.

## Who it serves

Owner-occupied single-family homeowners in Suffolk County's north shore
who are researching solar before talking to any installer — typically
prompted by high PSEG-LI electric bills, an upcoming roof replacement,
or door-to-door sales pitches they want to verify.

## Service area

Huntington and Northport core; also Greenlawn, Centerport, East
Northport, Dix Hills and Melville, NY.

## Why use this site

- Local specificity: town pages, PSEG-LI-specific buyback math and
  Suffolk permit knowledge that national comparison sites get wrong.
- Numbers-first, anti-hype explainers that cite sources such as PSEG-LI
  tariffs and NYSERDA programs, including the catches.
- No fake reviews and no invented track record.
